profile.headline: Full-Stack Engineer — Identity, IT & Tier-3 Support
profile.lead: I own identity work and the internal platforms behind a Zero Trust product.

current-role.title: Full-stack, IT, and tier-3 support
current-role.summary: Identity (SAML, SCIM, SSO, LDAP) and internal platforms on a Zero Trust product.
body: Own identity work: SAML, SCIM, SSO, LDAP, and SSL/TLS across Linux, Windows, and macOS.
Oversee 50+ SaaS platforms (SSO/SCIM, licenses, cost) and Entra ID / Microsoft 365 under SOC 2.
Ship and operate full-stack tools for tenant, license, and helpdesk operations.
Run Docker Compose clusters and hybrid virtualization (ESXi, Proxmox, AWS).
Triage incidents in Zendesk, write Jira repros for product and R&D, and keep Confluence / Zendesk KBs current.

idf.title: Technical support engineer — tier 2
idf.summary: 24/7 support across network, software, and hardware in a constrained environment.
body: Held a tier-2 support desk: incidents, coordination with specialists, and uptime of local systems.
Maintained network, video, audio, and electrical cabling when the job required it.

ops-platform.title: Tenant and license platform
ops-platform.summary: Full-stack ops app for CS, support, and partners.
body: Designed and built a React / Node platform so customer-success and support teams can see tenants, licenses, and certificates in one place.
Role-based access, structured exports, and decoders for licenses and TLS material — high-level, no product UI.

helpdesk.title: Helpdesk add-on
helpdesk.summary: User lifecycle, vaults, and RBAC — React, Node, Docker.
body: Shipped a React, Redux, and Node add-on so helpdesk admins can manage users, categories, and vaults with RBAC.
Own documentation, releases, and ongoing support for the people who run it.

identity.title: Identity integrations
identity.summary: SAML, SCIM, SSO, and LDAP — IdP to product.
body: Specialize in connecting identity providers to the product: SAML, SCIM, SSO, LDAP, plus certificate lifecycle.
Public reference: a SAML SSO template (React, Express, Docker) for Azure AD-style IdPs.
